mapper.select: select count(*) from posts where category_id = #{id} and status = 2

SELECT p.id AS id, p.title AS title, p.introduction AS introduction, p.image AS image, p.type AS type, p.post_type AS post_type, p.create_time AS create_time, p.update_time AS update_time, IFNULL(browse_count.browse_count, 0) AS browse_count, IFNULL(like_count.like_count, 0) AS like_count, IFNULL(collect_count.collect_count, 0) AS collect_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS browse_count FROM browse WHERE type = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) browse_count ON p.id = browse_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id AS post_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM likes WHERE type = 0 AND status = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) like_count ON p.id = like_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS collect_count FROM collect WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) collect_count ON p.id = collect_count.post_id WHERE p.category_id = #{po.categoryId} AND p.status = 2
AND p.title LIKE concat('%', #{po.postName}, '%')
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC
